stories.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

sources.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_zh: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久
sources.title_en: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用272个真实SFT任务对比：FLOP估算仅R²=0.31、MAE 12.41 h，仅用调度前信息的CatBoost达R²=0.98、MAE 1.71 h，解释微调为何常超FLOPs预期。

en.reason: Across 272 production SFT runs, FLOP-based estimates reached only R²=0.31 and 12.41 h MAE, while CatBoost using pre-scheduling information hit R²=0.98 and 1.71 h MAE, explaining why fine-tuning often outruns FLOP predictions.

stories.title: 港中深联合微软研究院提出 ConvexLLM：让声音跳过转写，直接调用大模型推理能力

sources.title_original: 港中深联合微软研究院提出 ConvexLLM：让声音跳过转写，直接调用大模型推理能力
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Microsoft Research 联合提出 ConvexLLM，其 C-Gate 架构以冻结词嵌入的非负加权组合把语音映射到文本词嵌入凸包，跳过转写直接调用大模型推理，避免中间步骤的信息损失和延迟。

en.title: CUHK-Shenzhen and Microsoft Research present ConvexLLM: skipping transcription so audio can tap directly into LLM reasoning
en.reason: ConvexLLM, from CUHK-Shenzhen and Microsoft Research, uses a C-Gate architecture mapping speech into the convex hull of frozen text word embeddings via non-negative weighted combinations, skipping transcription to call LLM reasoning directly and avoid intermediate-step information loss and latency.

stories.title: AI 自己动手改电路：OpenAI 让模型优化芯片，AMD 旗舰 GPU 性效比最高提 14%

sources.title: AI 自己动手改电路：OpenAI 让模型优化芯片，AMD 旗舰 GPU 性效比最高提 14%
sources.title_zh: AI 自己动手改电路：OpenAI 让模型优化芯片，AMD 旗舰 GPU 性效比最高提 14%
sources.title_original: AI 自己动手改电路：OpenAI 让模型优化芯片，AMD 旗舰 GPU 性效比最高提 14%
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 报告称 GPT-4o 改写 Jalapeño 电路，新乘法器面积减约15%、延迟降至单时钟周期；AMD 旗舰 GPU 上改写 SystemVerilog RTL 使 PPA 最高提升14%，约一年优化压到不足5个月。

en.title: AI edits circuits itself: OpenAI has models optimize chips, improving AMD flagship GPU performance-per-watt by up to 14%
en.reason: GPT-4o rewrote Jalapeño circuits, cutting a new multiplier's area by about 15% and latency to one clock cycle, while SystemVerilog RTL edits on AMD's flagship GPU lifted PPA up to 14%, compressing a year of optimization into under five months.

primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic以每股83美元定价、发行约9.8亿股，募资813亿美元超越SpaceX的750亿美元纪录，但早期投资人Dustin Moskovitz公开与其保持距离，警告自己的早期出资可能是“终结世界”之举。

sources.title_original: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
sources.summary:
OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing fast, with theoretical token costs now exceeding researchers' base salaries. Even though teams are reluctant to work without these tools, the models still produce a lot of "AI slop" beyond routine tasks.
OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing fast, with theoretical token costs now exceeding researchers' base salaries. Even though teams are reluctant to work without these tools, the models still produce a lot of "AI slop" beyond routine
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI报告称内部Codex和Dots用量激增，中位研究员按API价日均耗$2,400；101人调查中位宁舍40%团队或30%算力，也不愿三个月停用coding agents。

en.reason: OpenAI's median researcher burns $2,400/day in theoretical API token costs, and in a 101-person survey the median respondent would sacrifice 40% of their team or 30% of compute rather than stop Codex and Dots coding agents for three months.

sources.summary:
Pulling text out of scanned books and records has gotten a lot cheaper with freely available AI models.
Pulling text out of scanned books and records has gotten a lot cheaper with freely available AI models.
Pulling text out of scanned books and records has gotten a lot cheaper with freely available AI models. Daniel van Strien of Hugging Face compared eight such models that recognize text in images. He tested them on 850 pages from old natural history books, the 1771 Encyclopaedia Britannica, a
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hugging Face的Daniel van Strien用每小时2.75美元的Nvidia RTX PRO 6000测试8个OCR模型处理850页古籍，发现每千页成本从RolmOCR的51美分降到LightOnOCR-3-0.8B的不到10美分，百万页只需65至130美元。

en.reason: Hugging Face's Daniel van Strien tested eight OCR models on 850 pages from natural history books and the 1771 Encyclopaedia Britannica, finding per-1,000-page costs fall from RolmOCR's 51 cents to under 10 cents with LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, or $65–$130 per million pages.

stories.title: 更多银行表示，使用 AI Agent 的客户只能风险自负——即便遭到黑客攻击也不例外 / More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked

sources.title_original: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Citi成为最新一家对个人理财AI agent踩刹车的大型金融机构，而多家银行明确表态：客户用AI agent操作账户，即便被黑客入侵也须自担责任——这篇报道讲清了风险责任如何在银行与用户之间转移。

en.reason: Citi is the latest major bank to pump the brakes on personal-finance AI agents, while multiple institutions say customers who use agents to operate accounts bear liability even if hackers break in, shifting risk to users.

sources.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon：支持 100 万 Token 上下文，在 AA 编程 Agent 指数中排名第一 / Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index

sources.title_original: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，支持 1M 上下文，定价每百万 token 输入 3 美元、输出 15 美元，主打编程 agent 与知识工作；它在 Vals Index 得 70.9% 排第二，但 Terminal-bench 4.1 以 65.2% 略输 Claude Opus 5.5 的 65.8%。

en.reason: Gemini 4 Neon pairs a 1M-token context window with $3/$15 per million input/output tokens, targets coding agents and knowledge work, and tops the AA Coding Agent Index.

本期技术前线聚焦金融智能体从建得出来&到用出价值的关键跨越，围绕价值衡量、工程化落地、规模化运行与可信治理等方面，分享可验证的场景实践、可复用的建设路径与可对照的投入产出。

金融智能体正从技术验证转向价值落地，监管新规明确将业务价值导向与投入产出评估纳入强制要求。

适合金融科技架构师、AI工程负责人、监管科技合规工程师阅读。

2026 年 11 月

en.title: Value First: Putting Financial Agents into Practice | TF Tech Frontline Session 188 — Registration Open
en.summary:
This edition of Tech Frontier focuses on the critical leap financial agents must make from "buildable" to "value-generating," sharing verifiable real-world practices, reusable implementation paths, and comparable ROI across value measurement, engineering implementation, scaled operations, and trusted governance.

This edition of Tech Frontier focuses on the critical leap financial agents must make from "buildable" to "value-generating," sharing verifiable real-world practices, reusable implementation paths, and comparable ROI across value measurement, engineering implementation, scaled operations, and trusted governance.

Word count: 2,601
Estimated reading time: about 9 minutes

Financial agents are shifting from technical validation to value delivery, and new regulations explicitly make business value orientation and ROI assessment mandatory requirements.

Value measurement has become a mandatory regulatory capability; the "pragmatic and efficient" principle codifies cost-benefit balance in law for the first time; and the ten "AI + Finance" scenarios anchor the 2030 milestone for scaled empowerment.

Intended for fintech architects, AI engineering leads, and regtech compliance engineers.

Introduction: This edition of Tech Frontier focuses on the critical leap financial agents must make from "buildable" to "value-generating." Frontline technical experts from insurance, futures, and fintech are invited to share verifiable real-world practices, reusable implementation paths, and comparable ROI across value measurement, engineering implementation, scaled operations, and trusted governance. You are welcome to register and join the discussion.

CCF TF Tech Frontier, Session 188
Date:
November 2026

sources.title_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 发布：第 10 号元素「氖」
sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Neon 发布：第 10 号元素「氖」
sources.summary: 谷歌 Gemini 4 Neon 重磅上线，与氩、碳、氢模型各司其职，定位是 Agent 集群调度中枢，对标 Opus、Sol。它可以调度子代理协同攻坚，独立搭建复杂 3D 场景、前端工程，在多项基准测试中都胜过竞品。开发者们可以上手试试！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon（氖，10号元素），百万 token 输入$3、输出$15，比 Carbon 便宜，可在 Google AI Studio 调用。

en.title: Gemini 4 Neon launches: element No. 10, neon
en.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Neon is officially live, with the Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen models each handling their own role. Positioned as a central orchestrator for Agent swarms, it takes aim at Opus and Sol. It can dispatch sub-agents to work problems in concert, independently build complex 3D scenes and front-end projects, and beats competitors on multiple benchmarks. Developers can give it a try.
en.reason: Google's Gemini 4 Neon, priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, is cheaper than Carbon and positioned as an agent-cluster scheduling hub that coordinates sub-agents on complex 3D scenes and front-end engineering, beating competitors on multiple benchmarks.

大家好，我是G哥。我朋友公司，靠AI视频今年上半年赚了700万，在他的指导下，我写出了这篇文章。含金量你自己想，推荐你收藏认真看！​
想把脑海里的画面，变成一条能看的动画？​
这篇用一条约48秒的短片，从人物定妆讲到最后一击。Claude/Codex写分镜，Seedance生成动态，每一步都附图片和可复制的提示词。​
项目先限定在约48秒、16:9横屏，三个人物，一个场景，普通话对白，二维动画风格。片子要讲完一场冲突，有开头，也有结果。​
如果写到一半，又想加童年回忆、城市毁灭和新角色，就得多准备相应的图片、镜头与声音。第一次做，可以先把这些支线

en.title: Seedance + Claude/Codex: A step-by-step AI video generation tutorial, from storyboard to final cut (with full prompts)
en.reason: A roughly 48-second, 16:9 2D battle animation is broken into crisis, awakening and final showdown segments of about 16 seconds each, with Claude/Codex writing the storyboard, Seedance generating motion, and every step paired with images and copyable prompts.

stories.title: 模型刚接进业务，CEO又要换新：红帽如何接住企业AI落地难题？

sources.title: 模型刚接进业务，CEO又要换新：红帽如何接住企业AI落地难题？
sources.title_zh: 模型刚接进业务，CEO又要换新：红帽如何接住企业AI落地难题？
sources.title_original: 模型刚接进业务，CEO又要换新：红帽如何接住企业AI落地难题？
sources.summary:
“投入不小，但真正能够证明投资获得回报的案例还不多。”
“投入不小，但真正能够证明投资获得回报的案例还不多。”
本文字数：4008 字
阅读完需：约 13 分钟
企业AI落地面临模型快速迭代与Agent权限失控的双重挑战，基础设施需从单纯算力供给转向推理效率、资源调度与运行治理。
红帽聚焦GPU调度、Token生产、Agent细粒度权限管控及AI原生漏洞修复，支撑AI平稳进入生产环境。
模型切换成本高；Agent需严格限定数据访问与操作边界；AI基础设施须兼顾灵活性与可控性。
适合AI平台工程师、SRE、企业架构师阅读
“刚选定模型、完成平台搭建，业务流程也已经接入。但没过几天，市场上又出现一个表现更好的模型，CEO 转头就问 CIO：能不能也试试？”红帽全球副总裁兼大中华区总裁曹衡康（Victor Tsao）提到了企业落地 AI 时经常遇到的一个困境。
对企业来说，换模型并不像个人更换一个聊天工具那么简单。模型背后还连接着 GPU 适配、推理服务、数据接口和业务流程，前一套系统刚刚跑顺，新模型就来了，企业既不想错过技术进步，也不愿意为此重新搭建整套环境。
Agent 的出现又带来了另
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借llm-d 1.0在约7530亿参数模型上支持3000个并发编码Agent、峰值每分钟660万Token的测试，讲清企业AI落地既要应对模型快速切换，也要管住Agent权限。

en.title: Just Integrated a Model into Production and the CEO Wants a New One: How Red Hat Tackles Enterprise AI Deployment
en.summary:
The investment is sizable, but there are still few cases that truly prove a return.

4,008 words
About 13 minutes to read

Enterprise AI adoption faces the dual challenge of rapid model iteration and Agent permissions spiraling out of control. Infrastructure must shift from simply supplying compute to inference efficiency, resource scheduling, and operational governance.

Red Hat is focusing on GPU scheduling, Token generation, fine-grained Agent permission control, and AI-native vulnerability remediation to help AI enter production smoothly.

Model switching costs are high; Agent data access and operational boundaries must be strictly limited; AI infrastructure must balance flexibility and controllability.

Intended for AI platform engineers, SREs, and enterprise architects.

We had just selected a model, finished building the platform, and connected business processes. But within days, a better-performing model appeared on the market, and the CEO turned to the CIO and asked whether they could try it too. Victor Tsao, Red Hat's global vice president and president of Greater China, described this as a common dilemma enterprises face when implementing AI.

For enterprises, switching models is not as simple as an individual swapping a chat tool. Behind a model are GPU adaptation, inference services, data interfaces, and business processes. Just as the previous system starts running smoothly, a new model arrives. Enterprises do not want to miss technological progress, nor do they want to rebuild the entire environment for it.

The emergence of Agent has brought another...
en.reason: Red Hat’s llm-d 1.0 test supported 3,000 concurrent coding agents on a ~753-billion-parameter model at a 6.6 million tokens-per-minute peak, covering enterprise AI’s twin challenges of rapid model switching and Agent permission control.

en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

en.title: MUSE Advanced Guide: From Locking Faces to Controlling Camera Moves, Building a Complete AI Video Pipeline
en.summary: If you're new to Meta's personal AI assistant Muse, you've probably only used it to chat, look things up, or generate the occasional image. But once you actually try to produce a complete short video you'd be willing to publish, you'll likely hit the usual pain points: faces swapping, distorted limbs, slow playback on longer videos, and credits draining fast. The author shares some fixes for each — worth a try.
